mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_seller_lock (seller_id) VALUES (#{sellerId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE seller_id = seller_id
mapper.select: SELECT seller_id FROM settlement_seller_lock WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.settlement_id, i.order_id, i.gross_amount, i.commission_amount, i.commission_snapshot, i.refunded_amount, s.period_end, r.total_refunded, COALESCE(a.recorded_refunded, 0) AS recorded_refunded, COALESCE(a.recorded_deduction, 0) AS recorded_deduction FROM settlement s JOIN settlement_item i ON i.settlement_id = s.settlement_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total_refunded FROM refund WHERE status='SUCCESS' AND is_deleted=0 GROUP BY order_id) r ON r.order_id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, MAX(refunded_amount) AS recorded_refunded, SUM(amount) AS recorded_deduction FROM settlement_adjustment GROUP BY order_id) a ON a.order_id=i.order_id WHERE s.seller_id=#{sellerId} AND s.status='PAID' AND s.is_deleted=0 AND r.total_refunded > GREATEST(i.refunded_amount, COALESCE(a.recorded_refunded, 0)) ORDER BY s.period_start, i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_adjustment (seller_id, order_id, source_settlement_id, eligible_from, refunded_amount, amount) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{item.orderId}, #{item.settlementId}, #{item.periodEnd}, #{refunded}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.order_id, a.source_settlement_id, a.amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(u.amount) FROM settlement_adjustment_use u WHERE u.adjustment_id=a.id),0) AS applied_amount FROM settlement_adjustment a WHERE a.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND a.eligible_from <= #{periodStart} ORDER BY a.eligible_from, a.id
SELECT a.source_settlement_id, a.order_id, u.amount FROM settlement_adjustment_use u JOIN settlement_adjustment a ON a.id=u.adjustment_id WHERE u.settlement_id=#{settlementId} ORDER BY a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_adjustment_use (adjustment_id, settlement_id, amount) VALUES (#{adjustmentId}, #{settlementId}, #{amount})

INSERT INTO settlement_payout (settlement_id, reference, operator_id, amount, paid_at, remark) VALUES (#{settlementId}, #{payout.reference}, #{payout.operatorId}, #{payout.amount}, #{payout.paidAt}, #{payout.remark})
mapper.select: SELECT reference, operator_id, amount, paid_at, remark FROM settlement_payout WHERE settlement_id=#{settlementId}
